- **Checked:** Dana is a member of #north-team, so they can see Ilse's message. Nothing posted in the channel since then changes the figure. I also read #inc-qfl-sev1, which Dana is in, and it has nothing about seats.
- **Not confirmed:** I couldn't find any Quarrendon files in the share, so I had no renewal document to check 261 against. I told Dana that.
- **Earlier figure:** I mentioned the August 2025 count of 185 seats under Amendment No. 1, after Dana corrected their own 180, so it doesn't get mixed up with the renewal figure.

A seat count is an operational fact, so no approval was needed.
